# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Sorcerer level 2 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Sorcerer
# level-1 spontaneous spell-burden baseline to level 2 as chosen input only. It
# names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It
# preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat),
# the deterministic ability/feat posture from the level-1 fixture, and the same
# canonical bloodline and bloodline class-skill selections (Arcane, Knowledge
# [arcana]), adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Sorcerer burden surface: no Arcane Bond
# execution, no bloodline arcana, no bonus spells/feats at 3rd+, no spellbook,
# no spells known, no spell slots, no spell DCs, and no level-3+ progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-sorcerer-level2

race_id=race:human
class_level=class:sorcerer:2
ability=strength:8

ability=charisma:17
